name: ZINC-250k
description: A molecular graph dataset of approximately 250,000 drug-like molecules sampled from ZINC, used for molecular generation and property-prediction research. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Jin, W., Barzilay, R., & Jaakkola, T. (2018). Junction Tree Variational Autoencoder for Molecular Graph Generation. Proceedings of the 35th International Conference on Machine Learning, 2323–2332. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/jin18a.html

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: ZINC is a curated chemical database with dataset-specific terms; no standard SPDX identifier is asserted for this derived ZINC-250k subset. Review ZINC's current terms and the source-paper dataset details before use or redistribution. This record is loader-only and vendors no data.
